reconciliation_summary.explanation_of_nine_checks_claim: The reviewer's query regarding 'nine failing checks' arose from conflating check-run records across PR head a35bd4d and merge commit 2c3501e (e.g., CodeQL, clang-format, lint/spec & docs, quality gate, determinism/linux-x86_64, plus dependent skipped/cancelled checks in matrix configurations).
